purpose: Find scientifically important old objectives newly worth investigating because a later capability addresses a documented blocker.
importance_reference: Independent adjudicated overall importance 0..4; axes are collected separately. No unvalidated arithmetic weights are claimed optimal.
selection: Use development topics only to select paper and metadata budgets and ranking rules. Freeze before reading held-out labels.
limitations: Budgets and thresholds are design choices until validated on the independent dataset.
Abstract-only corpora support screening, not full-text failure or resource verification.
No feasible-to-run filter is allowed to silently erase high-importance ambitious research.
